description:
Ray Bradbury's Fahrenheit 451 is a classic of dystopian literature. Here he explores themes of censorship, entertainment, and how we may be amusing ourselves to death. We'll be looking at literature, philosophy, psychology, and more to explain how Bradbury's Dystopia attacks the heart of our humanity.
